reuse.why: Reuses the existing link wrapper, the holder query (now returned as ids) and the unlink account's update via an extracted clearAccountBankLink helper shared with unlinkAccount.

duplication.why: The unlink field reset is extracted rather than copied and assertBankAccountNotLinked is rebuilt on top of findLinkedBankAccountIds, so no logic is duplicated.

placement.why: The flag is handled in the shared per-provider link wrapper in app.ts and the holder lookup stays in link.ts beside the existing assertion.

scope.why: Only the link wrapper, the holder query, the extracted unlink helper and tests are touched; the rename of the wrapper matches its broadened role.

maintainability.why: One wrapper covers all six providers, the unlink state comes from one helper, and the old assertion is a thin layer over the new query.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Goes through guardBankAccountLink and link.ts helpers for every provider; unlink reset shared with unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the unlink update is extracted into clearAccountBankLink and reused.
